_source: THE source of truth for effect content. data/effects.json is generated from this file by tools/pool-to-tables.mjs and must not be hand-edited.
_imported: Migrated from the authoring spreadsheet by tools/csv-to-pool.mjs. That import is a one-off; edit this file from here on.
_tags: `slots` are anatomy/location pairs; `*/<location>` means every anatomy that has that location. Only bludgeoning, piercing and slashing roll a hit location: every other damage type keeps ONE table per anatomy, tagged `<anatomy>/general` (or `*/general`), so an effect meant for fire or acid needs a general slot or its damage tags select nothing. `damageTypes` may be ["*"] for all eleven. `rank` is 1-12 and the severity band derives from it (1-3 minor, 4-6 moderate, 7-9 severe, 10-12 grave), as does the order of the three rows inside a band. `rank: null` means untriaged — see content/COVERAGE.md.
_inherits: A 13+ entry may carry `inherits: "row12"` and a `transform` instead of its own mechanics: it reads as row 12 of whatever table it lands on, modified. Resolved at fold-in, so effects.json stays explicit.

entries.name: Annihilating Resonance
entries.text: The note finds the pitch a body breaks at and holds it there.

entries.name: Battered
entries.text: Something gives all at once and the ground arrives sooner than expected.

entries.name: Bisected
entries.text: The cut does not stop where cuts stop.

entries.name: Bleeding Cut
entries.text: A thin line opens and takes its time deciding how much to bleed.

entries.name: Bloody Mess
entries.text: More blood than the wound has any right to produce, and all of it visible.

entries.name: Brittle Flesh
entries.text: The cold goes all the way in. Skin has the give of old porcelain now.

entries.name: Broken Arm
entries.text: The arm bends where no joint is, and stays bent.

entries.name: Broken Back
entries.text: Something deep in the spine lets go with a sound felt more than heard.

entries.name: Broken Finger
entries.text: One finger points somewhere the others do not.

entries.name: Broken Foot
entries.text: The small bones go together, in a bunch, like dry sticks.

entries.name: Broken Hand
entries.text: The hand closes wrong and will not open again.

entries.name: Broken Jaw
entries.text: The jaw hangs slack and every word turns to noise on the way out.

entries.name: Broken Leg
entries.text: The leg folds mid-stride and takes the rest of the body with it.

entries.name: Broken Neck
entries.text: The head sits at an angle the neck was never meant to allow.

entries.name: Broken Rib
entries.text: A rib goes with a wet click and every breath afterwards finds it.

entries.name: Broken Skull
entries.text: The skull gives under the blow and does not come back.

entries.name: Broken Toes
entries.text: The toes crumple in the boot, and the boot keeps them there.

entries.name: Broken Wing
entries.text: A spar snaps midway out and the wing folds against itself.

entries.name: Bruised Tail
entries.text: The tail takes the blow full and hangs heavy afterwards.

entries.name: Bruised Wing
entries.text: The membrane blooms dark from the impact and will not catch air.

entries.name: Bruising Blow
entries.text: The limb takes the weight of it and goes dull and useless.

entries.name: Burned Feverish
entries.text: The burn goes past pain into something like fever, and the shaking starts.

entries.name: Burning Radiance
entries.text: Light kindles under the skin and burns outward, patient and clean.

entries.name: Carbonized
entries.text: What is left holds its shape until something touches it.

entries.name: Catch Fire
entries.text: The flame finds cloth, then hair, and settles in.

entries.name: Caved Cranium
entries.text: The blow lands square and the shape of the head changes.

entries.name: Chopped Neck
entries.text: The blade goes deep into the neck and stops against bone.

entries.name: Cleaved Ankle
entries.text: The ankle opens and the foot turns loose beneath it.

entries.name: Cleaved Appendage
entries.text: The limb parts most of the way through and hangs by what is left.

entries.name: Cleaved Finger
entries.text: The blade takes the finger at the knuckle, cleanly.

entries.name: Cleaved Forehead
entries.text: The steel splits the brow and lodges in the bone above the eyes.

entries.name: Cleaved Hand
entries.text: The hand comes apart along the line of the cut.

entries.name: Cleaved Muscle
entries.text: The cut goes through the muscle wall and the strength drains out of it.

entries.name: Cleaved Neck
entries.text: The blade finds the neck and takes nearly all of it.

entries.name: Cleaved Tail
entries.text: The tail opens along its length and hangs by a strip of hide.

entries.name: Cleaved Wing
entries.text: The wing splits from edge to shoulder and folds in on itself.

entries.name: Clipped Foot
entries.text: The blade catches the foot on the way past and takes something with it.

entries.name: Collapsed Chest
entries.text: The chest gives inward and does not fully rise again.

entries.name: Compound Fracture: Back
entries.text: Bone comes through the skin of the back, white and wrong.

entries.name: Compound Fracture: Finger
entries.text: The bone comes out through the knuckle.

entries.name: Compound Fracture: Foot
entries.text: Bone pushes out through the top of the foot.

entries.name: Compound Fracture: Hand
entries.text: The bone breaks and keeps going, out through the back of the hand.

entries.name: Compound Fracture: Rib
entries.text: The rib snaps outward and opens the skin from the inside.

entries.name: Compound Fracture: Wing
entries.text: The wing bone shears and breaks the skin of the membrane.

entries.name: Consuming Brilliance
entries.text: The light gets in everywhere and leaves nothing to hide behind.

entries.name: Consuming Void
entries.text: Something reaches in and takes years rather than blood.

entries.name: Corrosive Wound
entries.text: The acid finds a seam and keeps working long after the splash.

entries.name: Critical Internal Bleeding
entries.text: Nothing shows on the outside. Everything is happening under it.

entries.name: Crushed Appendage
entries.text: The limb flattens under the impact and never quite comes back.

entries.name: Crushed Larynx
entries.text: The throat collapses and the next breath has to be fought for.

entries.name: Crushed Leg
entries.text: The leg is pulped from hip to knee and the shape of it is gone.

entries.name: Crushed Shoulder
entries.text: The shoulder caves in and the arm hangs from ruined moorings.

entries.name: Crushed Torso
entries.text: The blow drives the chest inward and something inside gives with it.

entries.name: Crushed Wing
entries.text: The wing flattens under the blow, spars and all.

entries.name: Crushing Blast
entries.text: The air itself hits like a wall and something in the chest yields.

entries.name: Crushing Blow
entries.text: The limb takes the full weight and the shape of it changes.

entries.name: Cut Brachial
entries.text: The point finds the artery inside the arm and opens it.

entries.name: Cut Deltoids
entries.text: The shoulder muscle parts and the arm drops, dead weight.

entries.name: Dazing Blow
entries.text: The world tilts and takes a moment finding level again.

entries.name: Dead Leg
entries.text: The leg goes numb from hip to knee and stops answering.

entries.name: Declawed
entries.text: The blade takes the toes off at the root, all together.

entries.name: Deep Corrosion
entries.text: The acid works past skin into the meat beneath, quietly.

entries.name: Deep Slice
entries.text: The blade goes in deeper than the wound looks from outside.

entries.name: Destroyed Organs
entries.text: The blow lands and something vital stops working behind the ribs.

entries.name: Destructive Resonance
entries.text: The sound settles into the bones and keeps shaking them.

entries.name: Disemboweled
entries.text: The belly opens and does not keep what it was holding.

entries.name: Dislocated Knee
entries.text: The knee goes sideways and every step negotiates with it.

entries.name: Disoriented
entries.text: The world keeps turning after the head has stopped.

entries.name: Encased
entries.text: The ice closes over and there is no more air behind it.

entries.name: Eviscerated
entries.text: The torso opens from side to side and the ground catches what falls.

entries.name: Flash Frozen
entries.text: The cold arrives all at once. Nothing moves after it.

entries.name: Fractured Tail
entries.text: The tail breaks mid-length and trails uselessly behind.

entries.name: Frostbite
entries.text: The cold takes the feeling out of the extremities first.

entries.name: Frostburn
entries.text: The cold burns going in and keeps burning after.

entries.name: Funny Bone
entries.text: The whole arm goes to static from elbow to fingertip.

entries.name: Grazed Lung
entries.text: The point nicks the lung and each breath comes back a little short.

entries.name: Grazed Scalp
entries.text: The scalp opens and blood finds the eyes almost at once.

entries.name: Gut Punch
entries.text: The blow lands under the ribs and takes the air with it.

entries.name: Hamstring
entries.text: The blade goes behind the knee and the leg stops holding weight.

entries.name: Head Cracker
entries.text: The skull gives with a sound nobody in earshot will forget.

entries.name: Holy Unmaking
entries.text: The light does not burn. It simply decides the body is finished.

entries.name: Horrific Scar
entries.text: The wound will close. It will not close neatly.

entries.name: Impaled Gut
entries.text: The point goes into the belly and stays there.

entries.name: Impaled Stomach
entries.text: The blade drives through the stomach and lodges against the spine.

entries.name: Jarring Blow
entries.text: The impact runs up the limb and leaves it ringing and useless.

entries.name: Jaw Dropped
entries.text: The blade takes the jaw and the face is suddenly the wrong shape.

entries.name: Jolted
entries.text: The muscles all fire at once and none of them agree.

entries.name: Kebabed
entries.text: The weapon goes all the way through and stops on the far side.

entries.name: Kebabed Appendage
entries.text: The limb is run through end to end and the weapon stays in it.

entries.name: Knocked Down
entries.text: The legs go out and the ground comes up.

entries.name: Laid to the Bone
entries.text: The cuts go down past the meat until they find something white.

entries.name: Liberated Skeleton
entries.text: The acid takes everything that was not bone, and takes it quickly.

entries.name: Life Drained
entries.text: Something reaches past the body and takes from what is behind it.

entries.name: Lightning Rod
entries.text: The charge finds a path straight through and takes it.

entries.name: Lodged Weapon
entries.text: The blade goes into the arm and will not come back out.

entries.name: Lodging Blow
entries.text: The weapon buries itself in the limb and stays.

entries.name: Mortal Blow
entries.text: The blow lands exactly where a body cannot afford one.

entries.name: Muscle Lock
entries.text: Every muscle seizes at once and none of them will let go.

entries.name: Neural Overload
entries.text: Thoughts arrive out of order and none of them finish.

entries.name: Nicked Achilles
entries.text: The point catches the tendon behind the heel and the leg buckles.

entries.name: Nicked Carotid
entries.text: The point grazes the great vessel of the neck. Grazing is enough.

entries.name: Nicked Femoral
entries.text: The point finds the artery high in the thigh and opens a seam in it.

entries.name: Nicked Tendon
entries.text: The point catches a tendon in the wrist and the grip goes slack.

entries.name: Numbed Tail
entries.text: The tail goes dead from the base and drags.

entries.name: Obliterated
entries.text: The force arrives from every direction at once.

entries.name: Overhead Slash
entries.text: The blade comes straight down and the skull takes the whole of it.

entries.name: Persistent Acid
entries.text: It clings. Water spreads it, and it keeps eating regardless.

entries.name: Pierced Calf
entries.text: The point goes through the calf and out the other side.

entries.name: Pierced Hip
entries.text: The point drives into the hip joint and stays lodged in bone.

entries.name: Pierced Knee
entries.text: The point goes into the knee and the joint stops being a joint.

entries.name: Pierced Lung
entries.text: The lung is opened and every breath whistles where it should not.

entries.name: Pierced Muscle
entries.text: The point goes through the meat of the arm cleanly.

entries.name: Pierced Organs
entries.text: The point finds something soft behind the ribs and opens it.

entries.name: Pierced Skull
entries.text: The point goes through the skull and into what it was protecting.

entries.name: Pierced Stomach
entries.text: The stomach is opened and its contents go where they should not.

entries.name: Pierced Throat
entries.text: The point opens the windpipe and air goes out the wrong way.

entries.name: Pierced Wing Base
entries.text: The point drives through the wing where it meets the body.

entries.name: Piercing Blow
entries.text: The point goes in clean and comes out red.

entries.name: Pinned Arm
entries.text: The blade goes through the arm and holds it where it is.

entries.name: Pinned Leg
entries.text: The point drives through the leg and fixes it in place.

entries.name: Pinned Tail
entries.text: The tail is nailed down and every pull makes it worse.

entries.name: Plucked Eye
entries.text: The point takes the eye out of its socket entire.

entries.name: Pulped Appendage
entries.text: There is nothing left in the limb holding a shape.

entries.name: Pulped Leg
entries.text: The leg is meat and bone fragments in a sleeve of skin.

entries.name: Pulped Shoulder
entries.text: The shoulder is no longer a joint. It is a bag of pieces.

entries.name: Pulverized Leg
entries.text: The bones of the leg come apart into gravel.

entries.name: Pulverized Shoulder
entries.text: The shoulder shatters into pieces too small to name.

entries.name: Pulverized Spinal Column
entries.text: The spine comes apart under the blow, vertebra by vertebra.

entries.name: Pulverized Tail
entries.text: The tail is crushed flat along its length and hangs dead.

entries.name: Pulverized Wing
entries.text: The wing is broken in a dozen places and drags like a net.

entries.name: Punctured Aorta
entries.text: The point opens the great vessel above the heart.

entries.name: Punctured Brow
entries.text: The point goes in above the eye and blood curtains down over it.

entries.name: Punctured Carotid
entries.text: The neck opens and does not stop opening.

entries.name: Punctured Cheekbone
entries.text: The point lodges in the bone of the face and sticks fast.

entries.name: Punctured Face
entries.text: The point goes through the face and the world goes white for a moment.

entries.name: Punctured Heart
entries.text: The point finds the heart, and the heart stops arguing.

entries.name: Punctured Hip
entries.text: The point drives deep into the hip and the leg gives up.

entries.name: Punctured Knee
entries.text: The point goes into the knee and the leg folds under it.

entries.name: Punctured Lung
entries.text: The lung collapses around the wound and breathing becomes work.

entries.name: Punctured Muscles
entries.text: The point goes through the arm in more than one place.

entries.name: Punctured Neck
entries.text: The point opens the neck and the breath goes with the blood.

entries.name: Punctured Tail
entries.text: The point goes through the tail and out the far side.

entries.name: Punctured Wing
entries.text: The point opens a hole clean through the wing.

entries.name: Punctured Wrist
entries.text: The point goes through the wrist and whatever was held is dropped.

entries.name: Puncturing Blow
entries.text: The point sinks in deep and pulls back out slowly.

entries.name: Radiant Annihilation
entries.text: The light burns away everything it can reach and looks for more.

entries.name: Ribboned Torso
entries.text: The chest is opened in a dozen places, none of them shallow.

entries.name: Ringing Ears
entries.text: A high tone arrives and crowds out everything else.

entries.name: Rung Bell
entries.text: The head takes the blow and the lights go out for a while.

entries.name: Ruptured Eardrums
entries.text: Something bursts deep in the ear and the world goes muffled and sideways.

entries.name: Ruptured Organs
entries.text: Something behind the ribs tears and keeps tearing.

entries.name: Sapped
entries.text: The strength goes out of the limbs and does not come back.

entries.name: Scalped
entries.text: The blade takes hair and the skin under it in one pass.

entries.name: Seared Flesh
entries.text: The skin blackens and splits, and the pain arrives a moment late.

entries.name: Searing Light
entries.text: The light burns the eyes before they can close.

entries.name: Set Alight
entries.text: The fire has found something it likes and settled into it.

entries.name: Severed Appendage
entries.text: The limb comes away and the ground catches it.

entries.name: Severed Arm
entries.text: The arm is gone at the shoulder and the shock arrives before the pain.

entries.name: Severed Biceps
entries.text: The muscle of the upper arm parts and the arm hangs slack.

entries.name: Severed Ear
entries.text: The ear comes away and the side of the head goes hot and wet.

entries.name: Severed Femoral
entries.text: The great vessel of the thigh is opened and empties fast.

entries.name: Severed Fingers
entries.text: Fingers come away and land somewhere out of sight.

entries.name: Severed Foot
entries.text: The foot comes off at the ankle and the leg finds nothing beneath it.

entries.name: Severed Hand
entries.text: The hand comes away at the wrist, still holding what it held.

entries.name: Severed Leg
entries.text: The leg is taken above the knee and the world turns over.

entries.name: Severed Muscles
entries.text: The muscles of the arm are cut through and the arm stops answering.

entries.name: Severed Nose
entries.text: The blade takes the nose flush with the face.

entries.name: Severed Quads
entries.text: The front of the thigh opens and the leg will not straighten again.

entries.name: Severed Tail
entries.text: The tail comes away and lies twitching where it fell.

entries.name: Severed Tendons
entries.text: The tendons of the leg part and the foot goes loose.

entries.name: Severed Wing
entries.text: The wing comes away at the joint and the sky is gone with it.

entries.name: Shattered
entries.text: The force arrives and the body has no answer to it.

entries.name: Shattered Arm
entries.text: The bones of the arm break in several places at once.

entries.name: Shattered Back
entries.text: The spine breaks and everything below it goes quiet.

entries.name: Shattered Eye Socket
entries.text: The bone around the eye caves in and the eye goes with it.

entries.name: Shattered Foot
entries.text: The foot breaks into pieces inside the boot.

entries.name: Shattered Hand
entries.text: The hand breaks in more places than it has bones to spare.

entries.name: Shattered Leg
entries.text: The leg breaks in several places and folds in the middle.

entries.name: Shattered Neck
entries.text: The neck breaks and the head is only along for the ride.

entries.name: Shattered Rib
entries.text: The rib breaks into pieces and the pieces go inward.

entries.name: Shattered Skull
entries.text: The skull comes apart along seams it did not have before.

entries.name: Shattered Vertebrae
entries.text: The bones of the tail break through and the tail goes dead.

entries.name: Shredded Pectoral
entries.text: The chest muscle is opened in overlapping cuts.

entries.name: Signature Slash
entries.text: The blade takes its time and leaves something worth reading.
entries.note: If no armor worn, slice your signature on their chest and make a free intimidate check

entries.name: Skewered Arm
entries.text: The arm is run through end to end and pinned to nothing.

entries.name: Skewered Tail
entries.text: The tail is run through lengthwise and stays that way.

entries.name: Skewered Wing
entries.text: The wing is punched through at the joint and will not fold.

entries.name: Skewering Blow
entries.text: The point goes all the way through the limb and out the far side.

entries.name: Slashed Arm
entries.text: The arm opens along its length and the grip fails.

entries.name: Slashed Brow
entries.text: The brow splits and the blood goes straight into the eyes.

entries.name: Slashed Eye
entries.text: The blade crosses the eye and the eye does not survive it.

entries.name: Slashed Eyes
entries.text: The cut crosses both eyes in one pass and the world goes dark.

entries.name: Slashed Pectoral
entries.text: The chest opens and the arm loses its anchor.

entries.name: Slashed Tail
entries.text: The tail opens along its length and bleeds freely.

entries.name: Slashing Blow
entries.text: The edge opens a long wound that immediately begins to run.

entries.name: Slashing Sweep
entries.text: The blade takes the legs and the ground follows.

entries.name: Sliced Calf
entries.text: The calf opens and the leg will not push off it.

entries.name: Sliced Muscle
entries.text: The muscle of the arm parts along the cut.

entries.name: Sliced Tendons
entries.text: The tendons part and the fingers stop obeying.

entries.name: Sliced Wing
entries.text: The wing opens along the membrane and spills air.

entries.name: Slit Wrist
entries.text: The wrist opens and empties faster than it should.

entries.name: Soul Rend
entries.text: Something leaves that was never meant to, and something else moves in.

entries.name: Sprained Wrist
entries.text: The wrist turns past its limit and whatever it was holding is gone.

entries.name: Staggering Blow
entries.text: The blow lands and the legs need a moment to be convinced.

entries.name: Stunning Blow
entries.text: The head snaps back and nothing arrives behind the eyes for a while.

entries.name: System Shock
entries.text: Everything the body runs on stops at once and has to be restarted.

entries.name: Tendon Slash
entries.text: The blade goes behind the leg and the leg gives out.

entries.name: Tissue Liquefaction
entries.text: The acid stops eating skin and starts on what skin was covering.

entries.name: Vorpal Cut
entries.text: The edge goes through as though the body were not there.

entries.name: Waning Vitality
entries.text: Something is taken that has no wound to show for it.

entries.name: Winded
entries.text: The air leaves all at once and takes its time coming back.
